title: As electric two-wheelers gain a foothold, Belgian startup Any bets on cargo space
summary: Belgian startup Any launched LUV1, a modular electric motorcycle with 120 liters of cargo space designed for carrying bags, work equipment, or pets. This addresses a practical gap in the electric two-wheeler market by combining environmental sustainability with functional cargo capacity for commercial and personal users.
content: Launched by Belgian startup Any, LUV1 is a modular electric motorcycle with 120 liters of cargo space that can be used to carry bags, work equipment, or even pets.

zh.title: 随着电动两轮车站稳脚跟，比利时初创公司Any押注于货运空间
zh.summary: 比利时初创公司Any推出了LUV1，这是一款模块化电动摩托车，拥有120升的货运空间，可用于运载包裹、工作设备或宠物。这通过将环境可持续性与实用货运能力相结合，解决了电动两轮车市场的实际空白，适用于商业和个人用户。

title: Anthropic was illegally blacklisted by the Trump administration, court rules
summary: A federal judge ruled that the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unconstitutional, delivering a significant legal victory for the AI lab in its monthslong dispute with the Trump administration. The court found that invoking national security cannot justify retaliating against government critics who set boundaries on military AI use.
content:
On Thursday, a judge ruled that the Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic earlier this year was unconstitutional, delivering the AI lab a win in a monthslong rollercoaster of a battle with the Trump administration. 
The lawsuit, filed in March in a California district court, accused the Trump administration of unlawfully retaliating against Anthropic for setting "red lines," or unacceptable military use cases of its AI technology. 
"The empty invocation of national security is not a blank check to punish and retaliate against government critics," Judge Rita F. Lin, a district judge in the northern district of California, wrote in the ruling …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 法院裁定：Anthropic被特朗普政府非法列入黑名单
zh.summary: 一位联邦法官裁定，五角大楼将Anthropic列入黑名单是违反宪法的，为这家AI实验室在与特朗普政府长期纠纷中取得了重大法律胜利。法院认为，援引国家安全不足以成为报复政府批评者（这些批评者对军事AI使用设置了界限）的理由。

title: AI, athletes, and Keith Rabois: StrictlyVC is back in New York on September 10
summary: Venture capital boutique StrictlyVC is hosting an evening event in New York's West Village on September 10 featuring prominent investors and entrepreneurs discussing AI, sports investing, and venture economics. The invitation-only gathering will include cocktails, food, and networking.
content: A boutique StrictlyVC evening returns to New York's West Village on September 10 with Keith Rabois, Craig Shapiro, Jason Levien, Tristan Walker, Brynn Putnam, and Deven Parekh — covering AI, sports investing, community-building, venture economics, and politics, with cocktails, food, and networking throughout the night.

zh.title: AI、运动员和Keith Rabois：StrictlyVC将于9月10日回到纽约
zh.summary: 风险投资精品公司StrictlyVC将于9月10日在纽约西村举办晚间活动，邀请杰出投资者和企业家讨论AI、体育投资和风险投资经济学。这场仅限受邀出席的聚会将包括鸡尾酒、食物和人脉交流。

title: The GTA VI ‘extended look’ is now streaming on YouTube
summary: Rockstar Games officially published its nearly 27-minute "extended look" at Grand Theft Auto VI on YouTube following its Netflix premiere, showcasing gameplay featuring protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. The preview emphasizes atmosphere and locations over specific game mechanics and was captured from the PS5 version.
content:
Rockstar has officially published its "extended look" at Grand Theft Auto VI on YouTube and on its website, as promised. The in-depth preview, which "entirely" features footage captured from the PS5 version of the game, initially premiered on Netflix at 3PM ET. But because Rockstar allowed creators to post reaction videos, you've technically been able to watch the video on YouTube before the studio's official upload.

Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 《GTA VI》"扩展预览"现已在YouTube上流媒体播放
zh.summary: Rockstar Games在Netflix首映后，在YouTube上正式发布了其近27分钟的《侠盗猎车手VI》"扩展预览"，展示了以主角Jason Duval和Lucia Caminos为主的游戏玩法。该预览强调了氛围和场景，而非具体游戏机制，并由PS5版本录制。
